_doc: Designer knobs of the map screen HUD (design/ux/hud.md, Tuning Knobs; only the ones the greybox uses so far). lifespan_warn_share: the share of the lifespan left at or below which the lifespan readout warns (0..1). end_turn_cooldown: seconds after a turn during which End turn is refused. greybox: settings of the slice-1 greybox only (src/ui/greybox/map_screen.gd), to be replaced by the art bible's look. greybox.seed: the world seed the greybox starts with when no --seed is given. greybox.biome_colours: a flat placeholder colour per biome name of world_continent.json legend.biome_ids (hex RGB). greybox.unknown_colour: the colour of a biome missing from that list. greybox.place_radius_px / player_radius_px: marker sizes in layout pixels.
